### Introduction

- Prostatic cancer clinical trial (Byar & Green, 1980; PMID: 7013866) from Vanderbilt Biostatistics (`hbiostat.org/data`).

- High-dose estrogen was used in the 1970s–1980s to lower testosterone and slow prostate tumor growth.

- Dataset of manageable size, real-world untidiness, and rich potential for biological insights despite its historical age.

- Evaluate the impact of estrogen therapy and cardiovascular complications on survival across patient profiles.
